claims: Santos defeated Remo 2-0 on April 2, 2026, in a Brazilian Serie A match.
Goals were scored by Thaciano and Moisés.
Moisés scored late in the match.
Neymar provided the assist for the first goal.
The match was at Estádio Vila Belmiro (Urbano Caldeira), Santos, Brazil.
The competition was Brasileiro Serie A (2026).
Gabriel Brazão; Igor Vinícius, Lucas Veríssimo, Luan Peres, Escobar; Oliva, Gustavo Henrique, Neymar; Rony, Barreal, Thaciano.
